headline: Costa Rica Lowers 2026 and 2027 Economic Growth Forecasts to 3.2% and 3.3%
summary: Costa Rica's central bank lowered its growth forecasts to 3.2% for 2026 and 3.3% for 2027, driven by slowing export growth and shrinking free-zone jobs.
why: Central bank forecasts provide critical baseline data for macroeconomic modeling, sovereign debt risk assessment, and monetary policy expectations in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Costa Rica
impacts.why: Lowered growth forecasts reflect weaker macroeconomic activity.
